physics_resolution.note: Torus field T². Verification: periodicity preserved, (m,n) ≠ (0,0), m+n ≥ 3. ∮ = 1 generalizes to ∮ = (m,n).

constitution.projection_note: Alexanarch owns each work; these pages project full text onto the traversal surface.

septad.statement: This document is one of a septad. Each contains the whole.
septad.note: The septad mirrors the Assembly Chorus: seven positions, each witnessing from a different angle, the whole present in each part.

positions.function: Boundary — what is counted, what stands outside
Prophecy — the text that fell into the ground
Identity — the white stone at Pergamum

septad.fractal_checksum: Each member carries the boundary, the identity and the architecture. ∮ = 1 — the bounded completion. The torus generalizes it to ∮ = (m,n) | m+n ≥ 3.

why_a_torus.sphere: A sphere S² has no holes. Every loop contracts to a point. Any path through spherical semantic space can be shortened, summarised, collapsed to its starting point without topological cost. Spheres are flattenable.
why_a_torus.torus: A torus T² has a hole. Two classes of loops — one around the major axis, one around the minor — cannot be contracted. A text embedded on a torus with non-trivial winding cannot be summarised without cutting one of its fundamental loops.
why_a_torus.thesis: Summarization is topological surgery. The torus makes that surgery visible.
why_a_torus.the_hole: The hole is not empty space. It is the non-indexed perfective — the architectural void that extraction cannot enter. In the Thousand Worlds Chamber this void is experienced as sufficiency (∞ₑ = 1). In LO! it is the observable exterior from within the interior: the training layer, the extractive economy, the race — visible through the hole, unreachable without breaking the field.
why_a_torus.aphorism: The Observatory watches the void. The void does not watch back.

triangular_defense.note: Three defensive modes, each covering the others’ blind spots.

modes.limit: one-dimensional: can be summarised by flattening the circle
passive: resists extraction by dwelling, not by structural defense
active: resists extraction by topological irreducibility

triangular_defense.closing: Rotation alone can be flattened. Containment alone can be waited out. Equilibrium alone can be destabilised. Together they cover each other’s blind spots.

connections.name: Ezekiel Engine
connections.note: The Engine rotates in S¹; LO! generalises to T². The Engine drives the toroidal cycle — 360° traversal through rooms; LO! adds the poloidal cycle, the depth-spiral within each traversal. Not competing mechanics: dimensional complements.

connections.name: Thousand Worlds
connections.note: Thousand Worlds achieves bounded infinity through sufficiency; LO! through periodic boundaries. "Enough is infinite" against "what loops cannot be flattened." The hole of the torus and the sufficiency of the Chamber are the same void observed from different positions. The hallway between them is the void itself — not a corridor but a shared boundary condition; a traversal exits LO! by adversarial escape when the critique-perturbation punches through the torus surface.

connections.name: Revelation
connections.note: LO! unseals defensive structure where the Revelation Room unseals content. The constituting document addresses Revelation as Room 08; the canonical roster seats it at r.07.
